shortDescription: Create and manage certificates on the Hetzner Cloud.

options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: The endpoint for the Hetzner Cloud API. You can also set this option by using the C(HCLOUD_ENDPOINT) environment variable.

options.name: api_endpoint_hetzner
options.description: The endpoint for the Hetzner API. You can also set this option by using the C(HETZNER_ENDPOINT) environment variable.

options.name: api_token
options.description: The token for the Hetzner Cloud API. You can also set this option by using the C(HCLOUD_TOKEN) environment variable.

options.name: certificate
options.description: Certificate and chain in PEM format, in order so that each record directly certifies the one preceding. Required if certificate does not exist and I(type=uploaded).

options.name: domain_names
options.description: Domains and subdomains that should be contained in the Certificate issued by Let's Encrypt. Required if I(type=managed).

options.name: id
options.description: The ID of the Hetzner Cloud certificate to manage. Only required if no certificate I(name) is given

options.name: name
options.description: The Name of the Hetzner Cloud certificate to manage. Only required if no certificate I(id) is given or a certificate does not exist.

options.name: private_key
options.description: Certificate key in PEM format. Required if certificate does not exist and I(type=uploaded).

options.name: type
options.description: Choose between uploading a Certificate in PEM format or requesting a managed Let's Encrypt Certificate.
